discussion_comments.comment_body: In my opinion any new limit setting should be the same as current one (`1000` in this case).

We could probably just skip checking the parser and just warning on the tracking property, especially since `parser.name` will not always be the same for those who are using manglers to pack their app, which typically alters the function name.
done, removed the parser name check, and solely depended on the tracker variable.
You should use the setting functions to access settings, not direct access to the object. Direct object access was deprecated in 3.0.
Do not pass in non-booleans to the sub module, because that is just asking for undefined behavior later. The etag option only accepts true or false.

we could even kill the `|| callback` operation which will be the most common use-case and just add:

```
app.set('jsonp callback name', 'callback');
```

in application.js https://github.com/visionmedia/express/blob/master/lib/application.js#L84

I dont think many people will be changing it
